scene: Alpenglow, no environment. Launch with -page mcp -mcpServer alpenglow-mcp (or choose MCP Servers, ⌘2, and click Alpenglow MCP). Wait for the check to finish (green dot in the sidebar). Scroll to the top.

Alpenglow, MCP Servers page. Click + in the sidebar's Servers header, choose Add MCP Server…. Name: GitHub, Transport: Local command (stdio), Command npx, Arguments -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github. Cancel afterwards.
Alpenglow, MCP Servers page, Alpenglow MCP selected and checked. Scroll down to the How a model sees this server card. Leave The list as a provider receives it closed.
frame: the How a model sees this server card

scene: Needs a model provider in Settings › Assistant (Ollama with a small model is free; allow the one-time permission). Alpenglow, MCP Servers page, Alpenglow MCP checked. In the Try with a model card type: Is the two-person tent in stock? and click Try. Wait for the answer (a call to search_catalog or get_product).
frame: the Try with a model card

scene: Alpenglow, no environment. Launch with -page specs -spec alpenglow.yaml (or choose Specs, ⌘3, and click Alpenglow demo shop). Editor switch on Visual. The sidebar shows the outline (Overview, ENDPOINTS, SCHEMAS) under the spec list and inventory.proto under Proto Files.

Alpenglow, Specs page, alpenglow.yaml open. Switch Editor to Code and break two things so lint reports them: delete the description line of the 200 response of GET /products/{sku} and change one tag of an operation to Shoes. Then click the problems count in the bar above the editor. Undo the edits (⌘Z) after the shot.
frame: the Problems popover and the bar above it

scene: Alpenglow, Specs page, alpenglow.yaml open, Editor on Visual. In the sidebar outline click GET /products, so its card opens in the Endpoints card. Scroll so the endpoint's fields, Parameters, Request Body and Responses are in view.

Alpenglow, no environment. Send every request in the Catalog folder (Run Folder works). Right-click Catalog in the Requests sidebar, choose Document in OpenAPI Spec…. Spec: New Spec, title Catalog, Link on. Click Document and wait for the result. Delete the new spec and unlink the folder afterwards (or use a copy of the workspace).
frame: the Document in OpenAPI Spec sheet

scene: Alpenglow, Specs page. Click inventory.proto under Proto Files in the sidebar. The bar shows No problems; the outline on the right shows the Inventory service with ListWarehouses, WatchStock and Reserve.

Alpenglow, no environment. Mocks page (⌘4): + › Mock of Alpenglow demo shop. Click Start. In the Responses card, set GET /orders/{id} to its 404. From Terminal run: curl http://127.0.0.1:4010/v1/products, curl http://127.0.0.1:4010/v1/products/TNT-MH-2P, curl http://127.0.0.1:4010/v1/orders/ord_7Hk2Lw, and curl -X POST http://127.0.0.1:4010/v1/orders -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{}' (a 400 with reasons), so the log has four lines. Delete the mock afterwards.

The mock from mocks-running, running. In the Routes card paste the orders example from the Scripted routes page (let orders = [] …) and click Save Routes, so the line Running: POST /orders, GET /orders/:id shows. Delete the mock afterwards.
